name: Corella Resources Limited
summary: Corella Resources Limited engages in the exploration of kaolin and silica projects in the Yilgarn Craton region of Western Australia. It holds interest in the Tampu kaolin, Wiltshire kaolin, Kalannie kaolin, and Bonnie Rock silica projects. The company was formerly known as Sinetech Limited and changed its name to Corella Resources Limited in April 2021. Corella Resources Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Leederville, Australia.
